intervention_summary: p369 amp(held−normal)=-0.1694; p158=-0.1879; p183=-0.1308; ordinary median/p90=0.5293697655154085/0.6905373575860457. If ordinary controls amplify as much as p369 when refs are held, the intervention is not leak-specific.
decision: **No complementary common-mode feature proposed.** p369 does **not** contain distinctive coherent pressure *drop* that relationships suppress: network median ΔP = 0.16 m (rise, not drop); 0% of targets have ΔP < −0.05 m; strongest measured drop is only -0.03 m at n410. Same-direction motion (frac=0.919) is mostly co-movement upward. Ref-hold amp(held−normal) = -0.1694 (negative ⇒ holding refs does **not** amplify a leak-like residual; ordinary large-drop controls amp median 0.5294). By contrast p158 HIT has localized drop -0.165 m at n644 with score_max=72.99. Raw/context patterns for p369 overlap mild ordinary variability; inflow/tank Δ (PUMP_1=-0.08, T1=0.315) are not a distinctive leak signature. **Do not** claim removing references would recover p369. Retain it as a genuine unresolved signal failure under relationship residuals.
